text:
The evidence can't tell you whether clearing is happening today. It covers only 2021, and the annual series ends in 2025, so it isn't a current-state view.

For 2021, Hansen/UMD mapped about 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss (2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property). The JRC 2020 map agrees that 98% of that area was forest at the end of 2020. Another 37.3 ha of loss was in patches under 0.5 ha and wasn't counted as an event.

Most of the affected area (68.1 ha) is mapped as planted pine (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), with 13.2 ha outside mapped forest and no native forest. Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, so this may simply be plantation harvesting.

The data doesn't establish deforestation, cause, legality, or who was responsible. To answer your question, you would need a query of 2022–2025 loss on this property, or more recent imagery.
